courses.title: Mindfulness Meditation with IMMI
courses.description: A self-paced, six-module introduction to mindfulness meditation for beginners, developed by IONS research director Helané Wahbeh and colleagues. Each module of about an hour combines video teaching, guided exercises such as breath awareness and body scans, reflection questions and a home practice, including ways of being with difficult emotions and thoughts.
